title: Two new models join the API
summary:
A garden-maintenance day with two new models, smoother multi-provider routing, and fewer operational loose ends.

Claude Opus 4.5 is now available through Bedrock with sensible default token handling, and Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) joins the image lineup. More capable text and image experiments, same HTTP-shaped interface.

OpenAI schema validation was relaxed so requests can travel more smoothly across providers. A Portkey gateway deployment path was also automated, because routing models should not require a small pilgrimage.

The image service health check now uses its /about endpoint, and the Wrangler deployment command no longer forces an environment that could get in the way. Small operational changes, fewer mysterious red lights.
